q: Kill 5 Elder Mountain Boars and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 12 minutes.
Bring 5 Flasks of Oil to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
Give Sara Timberlain the Stormwind Armor Marker.
Bring 6 samples of Lake Creeper Moss, 6 samples of Lake Skulker Moss and a Hardened Tumor to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
Deathguard Samsa of Tarren Mill wants 30 Hillsbrad Human Skulls.
Slay 10 Crushridge Warmongers, then return to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.
Deliver Trol'kalar to Zengu in Hammerfall.
Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.
Gather Searing Collars from the cultists in Skull Rock.
Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.
Kill Ambassador Infernus in Angor Fortress and bring proof of his death to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.
Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
Kill 8 Razormane Geomancers, 8 Razormane Defenders, and Kreenig Snarlsnout.
Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
Bring a Razormane Backstabber, a Charred Razormane Wand and a Razormane War Shield to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
Speak with Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post after seeing Feero safely through Ashenvale Forest.
Bring a Webwood Egg to Gilshalan in Aldrassil.
Kill Lord Melenas and bring his head to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
Kill Ursal the Mauler and return to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.
Free the spirit of Anaya Dawnrunner and bring her pendant back to Cerellean Whiteclaw in Auberdine.
Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.
In Defense of the King's Lands
Kill the Trogg leader, Grawmug, and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler then report back to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.
Bring Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's Mechanical Arm to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Retrieve the Cloven Hoof for Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.
Bring 12 Electropellers to Wizbang Cranktoggle in Auberdine.
Retrieve Haggard's Badge from Dead-tooth Jack's camp, and return to Marshal Haggard.
Gershala Nightwhisper in Auberdine wants 8 Corrupt Brain stems.
Bring Balnir Snapdragons to Anastasia Hartwell in the Mage Quarter of the Undercity.
Retrieve the Compendium of the Fallen from the Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and return to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
Energize Troyas' Stave and find the Equinex Monolith.
Escort OOX-17/TN to Steamwheedle Port, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
Retrieve Khadgar's Essays on Dimensional Convergence and deliver them to Watcher Mahar Ba in Nethergarde Keep.
Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.
Eridan Bluewind in Felwood wants you to kill 8 Jadefire Hellcallers, 8 Jadefire Betrayers, 8 Jadefire Tricksters, and Xavaric. Return to Eridan when the task is completed.
Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.
Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!
Find Fras Siabi's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Siabi's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.
Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.
Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
Find and slay the murloc known as Murkdeep. The creature is thought to be defending the murloc huts south of Auberdine along the water.
Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.
Escort the Gizelton Caravan through Mannoroc Coven. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.
Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.
Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.
Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.
Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay Bloodfury Ripper and bring her remains as proof of your deed.
Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.
Bring a Libram of Protection, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 1 Frayed Abomination Stitching to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Protection.
Seek out Overlord Runthak in the Valley of Strength.
Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.
STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.
Travel to the Wildpaw cavern located southeast of the main base in Alterac Valley and find the Frostwolf Banner. Return the Frostwolf Banner to Warmaster Laggrond.
Paragons of Power: The Confessor's Wraps
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Stanchion. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Retrieve the Arcane Shard from Morphaz and return to Archmage Xylem.
Bring the Tooth of Morphaz to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
Hold five bases in Arathi Basin at the same time, then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
Do a chicken emote at Innkeeper Norman, and in exchange you'll receive an Undercity Mint!

Bring 5 Cenarion Combat Badges, 3 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 7 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Friendly reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

Bring the the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of War, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Silver Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj. This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.
Bring 1 Qiraji Regal Drape, 2 Lambent Idols, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Shadowcraft Boots, Shadowcraft Pants and Shadowcraft Spaulders.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Shadowcraft Boots, Shadowcraft Pants and Shadowcraft Spaulders.
Give Deliana your Dreadmist Mask and Dreadmist Robe.
Give Mokvar your Dreadmist Mask and Dreadmist Robe.
Bring a Cord of Elements and a set of Gauntlets of Elements to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Using the Pure Hearts, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Pure Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
Using Dogran's Pendant, summon and subdue a succubus, then return Dogran's Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
Using the Heartswood Core, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Heartswood Core to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Slaughtered Lamb.

Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Bracers if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Bracers, 6 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar, 2 Cured Rugged Hides and 10 gold pieces.

Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Shoulderpads if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Shoulderpads, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.
Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 2 Frozen Runes, 2 Essence of Water, 2 Blue Sapphires and 30 gold pieces.
Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
